title: IR-Runbook-Phishing-Response
summary: Original summary for containing phishing delivery, assessing user impact, and securing compromised identities.
content:
## 1.1 [Immediate] Remove the phishing message
Search tenant mailboxes by sender, subject, and message identifier, then quarantine or hard-delete confirmed malicious messages to prevent further clicks.

## 1.2 [Immediate] Block known sender infrastructure
Block confirmed sender addresses, domains, and sending infrastructure at the mail gateway; preserve indicators for investigation.

## 2.1 [Investigate] Identify affected users and payloads
Correlate safe-link or mail-gateway click telemetry with credential submissions, and inspect attachments in an isolated analysis environment.

## 3.1 [Recover] Revoke sessions and reset exposed credentials
Revoke active identity sessions and refresh tokens for affected users, reset exposed passwords, and verify that no attacker-registered MFA methods remain.
